topPRs.title: eth/071: U20 (v8.0.0-rc.3) OPCM upgrade — OP Mainnet, Ink, Soneium, Unichain
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Stacked on #1502 (the OPCMUpgradeV800 template). 

Mainnet counterpart of #1536: adds `src/tasks/eth/071-U20-op-ink-soneium-uni`, U20 on mainnet chains, using the **op-contracts/v8.0.0-rc.3** OPCM on Mainnet at [`0x1951828ce913dc4383a8a1695695d537a11d896a`](https://etherscan.io/address/0x1951828ce913dc4383a8a1695695d537a11d896a) (version `8.0.1`, per superchain-registry `standard-versions-mainnet.toml`).

| Chain | Chain ID | Rotates to |
|---|---|---|
| OP Mainnet | 10 | SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) |
| Ink | 57073 | SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) |
| Soneium | 1868 | SUPER_PERMISSIONED (5, permissioned-only — stayed permissioned in U19, no CANNON_KONA impl to carry over) |
| Unichain | 130 | SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) |

One transaction from the standard Mainnet L1PAO `0x5a0Aae59D09fccBdDb6C6CcEB07B7279367C3d2A` (2-of-2 Foundation Upgrade Safe + Security Council).

## Sequencing
- Stacked after the two pending mmzd tasks (`eth/067`, `eth/068`).
- Also sequenced after the Unichain PAO transition (`eth/069`/`eth/070` on `main`, DRAFT, gated on the Unichain governance vote). Those execute from the Unichain 3-of-3 (`0x6d5B...5833`) — no L1PAO nonce impact — but FUS and SC are child signers of that 3-of-3, so each consumes one FUS and one SC nonce. Pins are therefore L1PAO 42 (live 40 + 2), FUS 70 (66 + 4), SC 68 (64 + 4), and stay consistent whether or not 069/070 are present in the simulated tree.
- **`eth/069` MUST execute on-chain before signing** (it hands Unichain's L1 ProxyAdmin + DisputeGameFactory to the standard L1PAO). Simulation reproduces the post-069 state via owner-slot state overrides plus the `[addresses] ProxyAdminOwner` pin.

## Draft — blocking before signing
- [ ] All four `startingAnchorRootRoot` values are placeholders (`0xdead...`) and MUST be replaced with each chain's honest super root + timestamp, then re-simulated and VALIDATION.md hashes regenerated.
- [ ] `eth/069`/`eth/070` executed on-chain (governance-gated), ideally with a registry pin update, then Unichain's `expectedValidationErrors` re-captured.
- [ ] `eth/067`/`eth/068` executed (or pins re-derived); live nonces re-verified at signing time.

topPRs.title: sep/110: U20 (v8.0.0-rc.3) OPCM upgrade — OP, Ink, Soneium, Unichain Sepolia
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Stacked on #1502 (the finalized OPCMUpgradeV800 template set). 

Adds `src/tasks/sep/110-U20-op-ink-soneium-uni` U20 on Sepolia chains, using the **op-contracts/v8.0.0-rc.3** OPCM deployed on Sepolia at [`0x6AbfAbBC793883adD5fa308A97163E8225a9f4Ca`](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/address/0x6AbfAbBC793883adD5fa308A97163E8225a9f4Ca) (version `8.0.1`).

| Chain | Chain ID | Rotates to |
|---|---|---|
| OP Sepolia Testnet | 11155420 | SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) |
| Ink Sepolia | 763373 | SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) |
| Soneium Testnet Minato | 1946 | SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) |
| Unichain Sepolia Testnet | 1301 | SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) |

One transaction from the standard OP-governed Sepolia L1PAO `0x1Eb2fFc903729a0F03966B917003800b145F56E2` (2-of-2 Foundation Upgrade Safe + Security Council).

## Sequencing
- Stacked after the two pending mmzd tasks (`sep/105`, `sep/106`); nonce pins are the post-106 values (L1PAO 56, FUS 76, SC 70 — live values 54/74/68 on 2026-09-02).
- **External dependency:** Unichain Sepolia's PAO transfer from `0xd363...9dbf` to the standard L1PAO is executed by the Unichain Safe outside this repo (no signer overlap → no nonce impact here), and MUST land on-chain before signing. Simulation reproduces the post-transfer state via state overrides on Unichain's L1 ProxyAdmin (slot 0) and DisputeGameFactory (slot 0x33) owners, plus a `[addresses] ProxyAdminOwner` root-safe pin (same pattern as `sep/106`).

## Draft — blocking before signing
- [ ] All four `startingAnchorRootRoot` values are placeholders (`0xdead...`) and MUST be replaced with each chain's honest super root + timestamp, then re-simulated and VALIDATION.md hashes regenerated.
- [ ] Unichain PAO transfer executed on-chain (and ideally the registry pin updated, then `expectedValidationErrors` for 1301 re-captured).
- [ ] `sep/105` and `sep/106` executed (or nonce pins re-derived), live nonces re-verified at signing time.

topPRs.title: sep/108: U20 (v8.0.0-rc.3) OPCM upgrade — platforms-1
topPRs.author: jelias2
topPRs.body:
## Objective

Upgrades the **platforms-1** devnet (`420130013`) to Upgrade 20 (`op-contracts/v8.0.0-rc.3`) from the shared devnet ProxyAdminOwner Safe `0xe934Dc97E347C6aCef74364B50125bb8689c40ff` (1-of-1), rotating its respected game type from **CANNON_KONA (8) → SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9)**.

Same shape as sep/107 for sepolia-devnet-2, which starts from the same game type and shares the same Safe, OPCM and game implementations.

State before, read on-chain:

| Contract | Version |
|---|---|
| SystemConfig | 3.14.2 |
| OptimismPortal2 | 5.6.1 |
| DisputeGameFactory | 1.6.1 |
| AnchorStateRegistry | 3.9.0 |

`gameImpls`: 1 → `0xe1dFFCBE…`, 8 → `0x2DDA3584…`, 0/5/9 unset. `respectedGameType` → 8.

## Addresses

platforms-1 is not in the superchain-registry, so addresses come from [addresses.json](src/tasks/sep/108-U20-platforms-1/addresses.json) via `fallbackAddressesJsonPath`. Each address was taken from the chain's op-deployer state (`devnets-private@8810e39`) and cross-checked on-chain against `SystemConfig`, `OptimismPortal2`, `DisputeGameFactory` and `ProxyAdmin` getters.

## Absolute prestate

Custom `kona-client/v1.7.0-rc.2` `cannon64-kona-interop` build with platforms-1's chain config and a single-chain depset embedded:

```
0x030bec4509e7d0cf41cbd686cfeeca04f4cdb0c4048605a2f275e4f6edeaa73b
```

**Published** — `https://storage.googleapis.com/oplabs-network-data/proofs/kona/cannon/0x030bec45….bin.gz` returns HTTP 200.

Inputs are committed at `devnets-private@8810e39`, so it is reproducible from that commit:

```bash
netchef fault-proofs generate-prestates \
  --devnet-dir <devnets-private>/stg/platforms-1 \
  --monorepo-dir <optimism> \
  --prestate-type konaInterop
```

### An earlier prestate for this task was wrong — do not use it

`0x03fc24f31d8a439afbe11ed2de4bb155f4accfcb391da7bb4cb91ebbbb2ec48c` is also in the bucket and **must not be used**. It embedded `lagoon_time: 0`, which kona reads as active from genesis, so `is_interop_active()` would have been true for every block while the chain treats interop as never active — platforms-1 has no `lagoon_time` in `rollup.json`, `genesis.json` or `chain.yaml`. The cause was netchef flattening an unset `*uint64` to `0`; fixed in [infrastructure-services#1430](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infrastructure-services/pull/1430).

The rebuilt image's embedded config, read back out of the artifact:

```json
"hardfork_configuration": {
  "canyon_time": 0, "delta_time": 0, "ecotone_time": 0, "fjord_time": 0,
  "granite_time": 0, "holocene_time": 0, "isthmus_time": 0, "jovian_time": 0,
  "karst_time": 0,
  "keep_karst_upgrade_gas": true
}
```

matching `rollup.json` exactly, and matching the registry's shape for the U20 chains — times through Karst, the Karst gas flag, no Lagoon.

## Anchor state

Single-chain super root at finalized L2 block 6738774 (timestamp 1789068486), read from platforms-1's op-supernode `superroot_atTimestamp`. Part of the signed calldata and fixed once published — if this task is re-dated, regenerate the anchor and the VALIDATION.md hashes.

## Verification

`expectedValidationErrors` and the state changes in VALIDATION.md come from this task's own simulation, not copied from sep/107. Three proxies change implementation — SuperchainConfig 2.4.2 → 2.4.3, SystemConfig 3.14.2 → 4.0.0, OptimismPortal2 5.6.1 → 5.8.0 — and five are re-set to the implementation they already hold (verified by reading their ERC-1967 slots).

| | |
|---|---|
| Safe Hash | `0xd0aa5f15a132c91a1fdda16066602d0bda625f8d446021649e6f947b9b1ec748` |
| Domain Hash | `0x07e03428d7125835eca12b6dd1a02903029b456da3a091ecd66fda859fbce61e` |
| Message Hash | `0x0c2b045f66940ac6edbb515054eb0d90b36dd6d61ae9a7d83ef34c128b9c116b` |

## Status: DRAFT — one prerequisite remains

**platforms-1's op-challenger runs `OP_CHALLENGER_TRACE_TYPE=cannon,cannon-kona`.** netchef only selects `super-cannon-kona` for chains with the interop fault-proof feature (`pkg/generators/k8s/service/challenger.go:183-187`), which platforms-1 does not have. As deployed, the chain would have no honest actor on the game type this task makes respected. That is a devnet deployment change rather than task calldata, but it needs to land alongside.

The Safe nonce (147) and the anchor root both go stale; re-verify both before signing.

topPRs.title: eth/069-070: bump Unichain Chain Governor nonce pins after its 069 approval
topPRs.author: OptimismBot
topPRs.body:
## Why

The Unichain Chain Governor Safe [`0xb0c4C487C5cf6d67807Bc2008c66fa7e2cE744EC`](https://etherscan.io/address/0xb0c4C487C5cf6d67807Bc2008c66fa7e2cE744EC) **approved task 069 on-chain** in [`0xdc5de66b…4ecd1`](https://etherscan.io/tx/0xdc5de66b3683a3b09ed58adc26e66f2a91351ea42c7fec8edea8b98e7224ecd1) (block 25956808), taking its nonce from `19` to `20`. The state-override pins in 069/070 still assumed `19`/`20`, so `StateOverrideManager` rejected 069's pin and `stacked_simulation_eth` has failed on `main` since job [210418](https://circleci.com/gh/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/210418) (latest: [210469](https://circleci.com/gh/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/210469)).

Verified live: `cast call 0xb0c4…44EC "nonce()(uint256)"` returns `20`, and `approvedHashes[chain-governor][0x853896d5…4390]` on the 3-of-3 [`0x6d5B…5833`](https://etherscan.io/address/0x6d5B183F538ABB8572F5cD17109c617b994D5833) is `1`.

## What

| Task | CG pin | CG message hash |
|---|---|---|
| 069 | `19` → `20` | `0x28e77c5d…6197` → `0x3cbf706c1d884418b1747e65b9d5f4fc0cf22f4591ad9f47517b2df845259c85` |
| 070 | `20` → `21` | `0xe2d1b1a2…e6ed` → `0x3f3046779ff8be4fcb83c0e82311351d2cec5ae0d71877f9987629133748fdb6` |

Also updated the CG nonce before/after lines in both `VALIDATION.md` files, and added a note to 069 recording that the CG's approval is already on-chain.

**The root safe transaction hashes are unchanged** (069 `0x853896d5…4390`, 070 `0x586752c3…f2af`), so:
- The Foundation Upgrade Safe and Security Council domain/message hashes are untouched — no re-signing needed, and any signatures already collected stay valid.
- The Chain Governor's existing on-chain approval of 069 stays valid. Its hashes here only apply if it signs again.

069 is **not** executed on mainnet (1 of 3 child approvals in), so no `Status:` change — see [thread](https://optimism.slack.com/archives/C03N11M0BBN/p1789233150447599).

## Verification

- `just simulate-stack eth` (the failing CI job) passes.
- `just simulate-stack eth 069-… chain-governor` and `… 070-… chain-governor` pass, printing exactly the two hashes above.
- Both new hashes were also derived independently, by rebuilding the CG's `aggregate3Value(approveHash(rootHash))` SafeTx from the on-chain approval calldata: that reconstruction reproduces the *old* hashes byte-for-byte at nonce `19`/`20`, and yields the new ones at `20`/`21`.

Prompted by: maurelian

topPRs.title: fix(eth): bump Unichain Chain Governor Safe nonce pin in tasks 069/070
topPRs.author: OptimismBot
topPRs.body:
Fixes the failing scheduled `stacked_simulation_eth` job on `main`: https://circleci.com/gh/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/210596

## Root cause

The Unichain Chain Governor Safe [`0xb0c4C487C5cf6d67807Bc2008c66fa7e2cE744EC`](https://etherscan.io/address/0xb0c4C487C5cf6d67807Bc2008c66fa7e2cE744EC) advanced to nonce `20` on-chain after tasks 069/070 were authored, while `069-unichain-l1-ownership-transfers/config.toml` still pinned `19`:

```
Error: script failed: StateOverrideManager: User-defined nonce (19) is less than current actual nonce (20) for contract: 0xb0c4C487C5cf6d67807Bc2008c66fa7e2cE744EC in task config file: src/tasks/eth/069-unichain-l1-ownership-transfers/config.toml
```

## Changes

| Task | Safe | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| `eth/069-unichain-l1-ownership-transfers` | Unichain Chain Governor | `19` | `20` (live on-chain value) |
| `eth/070-unichain-l2pao-transfer` | Unichain Chain Governor | `20` | `21` (one ahead, 069 signs first) |

Both `VALIDATION.md` files are regenerated accordingly: the Chain Governor message hash and the Chain Governor nonce state-change rows.

Only the Chain Governor message hashes change. The Foundation Upgrade Safe and Security Council message hashes cover `approveHash(<root safe tx hash>)` under their own (unchanged) nonces, and the Unichain 3-of-3 root safe tx hash is unaffected by a child safe's nonce — re-simulation confirms both are byte-identical.

| | 069 | 070 |
|---|---|---|
| Chain Governor message hash | `0x28e77c5d…f6197` → `0x3cbf706c1d884418b1747e65b9d5f4fc0cf22f4591ad9f47517b2df845259c85` | `0xe2d1b1a2…e6e6ed` → `0x3f3046779ff8be4fcb83c0e82311351d2cec5ae0d71877f9987629133748fdb6` |
| FUS / SC message hashes | unchanged | unchanged |

## Live nonces re-verified on mainnet

| Safe | Live | 067 | 068 | 069 | 070 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unichain 3-of-3 `0x6d5B…5833` | 10 | — | — | 10 | 11 |
| Unichain Chain Governor `0xb0c4…44EC` | **20** | — | — | **20** | **21** |
| FoundationUpgradeSafe `0x847B…9D92` | 66 | 66 | 67 | 68 | 69 |
| SecurityCouncil `0xc281…Bd03` | 65 | 65 | 66 | 67 | 68 |
| L1PAO `0x5a0A…3d2A` | 40 | 40 | 41 | — | — |

Tasks 067 and 068 needed no changes — their pins still line up with the live values. Task 066 is `[CANCELLED]` and 065 is `[EXECUTED]`, so neither is in the stack.

## Verification

`just simulate-stack eth` — the exact CI command — now passes end to end (exit 0) against a mainnet fork, simulating 067 → 068 → 069 → 070 across all child-safe paths. No `StateOverrideManager` or `TaskManager` hash-mismatch failures remain.

> [!NOTE]
> Nonce pins are live-state-dependent. Signers should still re-verify with `cast call <safe> "nonce()(uint256)" --rpc-url mainnet` immediately before signing, per the `CAUTION` block in each `VALIDATION.md`.

Prompted by: @mds1
